task.ques: Look for a Coursera course (not Specialization) that teaches Java programming basics.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Java Programming for Beginners by IBM is a Coursera course, not a Specialization. It is beginner level and teaches Java basics including data types, variables, operators, control flow, arrays, and strings.
Source: https://www.coursera.org/learn/java-for-programming-beginners
Evidence: final.png shows the course title, course designation, beginner level, and learning topics together.
